rule_name: VDU-2 White Marker Board By Others Note Validation

geometry_logic.boundary_detection: Detect the White Marker Board scope ONLY by identifying the COMBINED structure: a large wall-mounted rectangular board outline (dashed or solid boundary) AND four circular mounting holes positioned near its four corners, appearing together as a single connected board structure in the upper portion of the elevation view. Both the rectangular boundary AND the four corner holes must be present together — neither alone is sufficient.
wall_interaction_conditions: A rectangular board outline (dashed or solid) is visible in the elevation view
Four circular mounting holes are visible near the four corners of that SAME rectangular outline
The rectangle and the four corner holes must belong to the same board structure, not separate/unrelated shapes elsewhere in the drawing
The board is mounted on or aligned with the wall/elevation surface, typically in the upper portion of the elevation
The physical board structure is identifiable purely by this combined rectangle + 4-corner-hole shape, even without a VDU-2 tag or note
geometry_applicable = true ONLY when BOTH the rectangular boundary AND the four corner holes are present together as one structure
geometry_applicable = false if only a rectangle/box is present WITHOUT the four corner holes, or if isolated circles are present WITHOUT a matching rectangular boundary connecting them
geometry_logic.expected_boundary_region: Around the wall-mounted rectangular board outline together with its four corner mounting holes, including the board surface between them. Do not depend on VDU-2 tags, leader lines, schedule references, or note text to determine geometry applicability. Do not mark geometry_applicable = true based on a rectangle alone or holes alone — the combined structure is required. This single image represents one elevation view; do not assume a separate view exists elsewhere within the same crop.

detected_text_variants: PROVIDE WHITE MARKER BOARD BY OTHERS
pass_condition: Arch drawing has VDU-2 or WHITE MARKER BOARD AND submittal has MARKER BOARD BY OTHERS note.
fail_condition: Arch drawing has VDU-2 but submittal is missing MARKER BOARD BY OTHERS note.
VDU-2 scope confirmed from arch but no BY OTHERS responsibility note found in submittal.
review_required_condition: VDU-2 scope is applicable but the note text is unclear or partially readable.
VDU-2 tag is visible but its connected object or leader region is unclear.
Schedule shows VDU-2 as White Marker Board, but drawing location is ambiguous.
Multiple nearby notes create uncertainty about whether the BY OTHERS note belongs to VDU-2.
omit_condition: Arch drawing does not contain VDU-2 or WHITE MARKER BOARD — scope not applicable.
ARCH REF not found in submittal and arch drawing not available.
Drawing sheet does not contain VDU-2 scope.
Rectangle boundary present without the four corner holes, or corner holes present without a matching rectangle — combined structure not confirmed.
markup_label: VDU-2 MARKER BOARD BY OTHERS — CHECK

reasoning.description: Explain whether VDU-2 / White Marker Board scope is applicable, whether the BY OTHERS responsibility note is found, and why the final status is PASS, FAIL, OMITTED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED.
